Name: Animal Crossing Villager Cats for Adopt n' Skin or Alternative Textures
Author: TerraTerraCotta
Description:
[size=4][u][b]Description[/b][/u][/size]
Stardew Valley is a lot like Animal Crossing, isn't it? A very relaxing, work-at-your-pace game. Well why not bring some of the Animal Crossing into Stardew Valley?

Using Adopt n' Skin, any other retexture mod, or even Alternative Textures you can turn your cat into one of a few different Cat Villagers from Animal Crossing!

[b]Villagers include:[/b] Rosie, Blanca, Katt, Olivia, Lolly, Bob, Rover, Punchy, and Meow!
Each one has their own special animations for a few of the actions the cat can do. 

[u][b]CREDITS[/b][/u]
Skins were reformatted, tested, and put together by TerraTerraCotta.
[i](These Skins were tested using Adopt N' Skin and Alternative Textures)
[/i]
Sprites were created by [b]NO Body[/b] on the Spriter's Resource as a part of their Harvest Moon NES-styled Animal Crossing Sprites
